i1.say: December in Davos. The arena is shaking, and millions follow the Spengler Cup. But online, all they can do is watch.

i2.say: Like the newcomer. A family member, a holiday guest in Davos. The referee blows the whistle, the whole arena reacts, and they have no idea what just happened.

i3.say: And the fan, who lives for this game and thinks: I could do that too. But how good are they really?

h1.cap:
In the Game:
right in the middle of it.
h1.say: In the Game puts both of them right in the middle of it.

l0.say: For the newcomer: Learn the Game.

a1.cap: Live on your phone, while the game is on.
a1.say: Live on your phone, while the game is on. You watch, you cheer, and then: the whistle.

a3.say: That's the moment. You see what was called, and why, in plain words. Suddenly, you're part of it.

s1.cap: Slashing: a chop across the forearm.
s1.say: And this is how the referee shows it. A chop across the forearm: slashing.

a4b.cap: Live tracking data knows why play stopped.
a4b.say: It all runs on live tracking data. The moment play stops, you already know why.

s2.cap: High-sticking: both fists up, like a raised stick.
s2.say: High-sticking. Both fists held up, one above the other, like a stick raised too high.

a7.say: Every rule you learn goes into your rulebook, and earns you ten points.

t1.cap:
Ever dreamed of being part of the Spengler Cup?
This is your chance.
t1.say: And for the fan: ever dreamed of being part of the Spengler Cup? This is your chance. Be a Pro.

m0.cap: In the break, or after the final whistle.
m0.say: In the break, or after the final whistle, the key scenes come back. In two modes.

m1.say: In Replay mode, you relive them like a broadcast. Every player, every pass.

m2.cap: Game mode: the scene freezes. Your call.
m2.say: In Game mode, it's your call. The scene freezes. Where does the puck go next?

p3.cap: Draw your pass. Then the real play rolls on.
p3.say: Draw your pass. Then the real play rolls on, and you see how close you were.

p4.cap: The closer you get, the more points.
p4.say: The closer you get, the more points you score.

p5.cap: Who reads the game best? You, or your friends?
p5.say: So who reads the game best? You, or your friends?

r1.cap: Rule points + pass points = your Hockey IQ.
r1.say: After the game, it all adds up. Points for every rule you learned and every pass you read. That's your Hockey IQ.

r2.cap: Redeem your points: discount codes, fan gear, prizes.
r2.say: And your points are worth something: discount codes, fan gear, maybe even a ticket for the final.

end.say: Every whistle. Every pass. Every game. Don't just watch. Be in the game.
